  "reasons": [
    "B is the clearest explicit motive: Kabir wanted something to read that evening.",
    "A is also defensible: he put the diary back immediately after discovering its pages were mostly expense tables.",
    "Because the passage supports both explanations, there is no single defensible answer."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Narrative Passage",
  "syllabus_topic": "Reading comprehension: identifying reasons for a character’s decision",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,

  "principle_applicability": "skill_from_stem",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": false,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Before putting the diary back, Kabir found that most of its pages contained blank tables for recording expenses.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Kabir wanted something to read that evening.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "He returned it after discovering most pages were expense tables, so that discovery prompted the return.",
      "correct_under_reading": true,
      "reading_status": "stated_by_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "He liked the cover when choosing the diary, then changed his mind about it before returning it.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "strained",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "His sister may have told him it was too expensive earlier, though the passage does not mention that.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "strained",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [
    {
      "category": "multiple_correct_options",
      "detail": "A is reasonably supported by the immediate sequence of discovering the expense tables and returning the diary; B is explicitly given as his motive for wanting a book to read that evening."
    }
  ],
  "style_notes": [
    "Original practice item; no authenticated matched comparator was supplied.",
    "The question’s broad “why” wording permits both the immediate trigger and the explicitly stated motive."
  ],

    "criteria": {

      },

        "level": 1,

  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Before paying, he opened it and found that most pages contained blank tables for recording expenses. He put it back and chose a collection of travellers’ stories instead.",
      "reason": "The discovery immediately precedes the return, making it a defensible reason for putting the diary back."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "On the way home, he told his sister that the first book would have been useful for planning a trip, but he wanted something to read that evening.",
      "reason": "The passage explicitly states that he wanted something to read that evening."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "He no longer liked the look of its cover",
      "premise_source": "passage_scope",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Kabir chose a travel diary because he liked its cover.",
      "reason": "The passage says he liked the cover and gives no indication that his opinion changed or that the cover prompted the return."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "His sister had told him it was too expensive",
      "premise_source": "passage_scope",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "On the way home, he told his sister that the first book would have been useful for planning a trip, but he wanted something to read that evening.",
      "reason": "The passage describes Kabir telling his sister why he wanted a different kind of book; it does not state or imply that she told him the diary was expensive."
    }
  ]
